queries: SELECT o.observstation, COUNT(t.telescregistry) AS telescope_count, COUNT(t.telescregistry) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM observatories AS o LEFT JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;
SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes), 0) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation ORDER BY share DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: At least 10 observatory stations exist; otherwise no query can return exactly 10 distinct stations.

alternatives.interpretation: Show only stations that have at least one telescope.

assumptions.assumption: Stations with no telescopes are eligible; at least 10 observatories exist. If there are no telescopes, shares are NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: Include only stations that have at least one telescope.

assumptions.assumption: The database has at least 10 observatory stations and at least one telescope; otherwise exactly 10 rows or a defined share is impossible.
